proof: For every projection, the Haussler--Littlestone--Warmuth density lemma gives $|E|/|V|\le\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$. Since this parameter is twice that density (the average degree), it is at most $2\,\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)$. Thus $\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)\ge\tfrac12\,\mathrm{dens}^p(\mathcal H)$.
name: VC Dimension / Projected Double Density or Projected Average Degree
